lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 003: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the ratchet-satisfied-by-deleting-docs finding recorded in this story's prd.json notes: US-002 (CAM-401) had satisfied src/commands/status.ts's file-size ceiling (1012) by compressing/deleting three pre-existing comment blocks unrelated to CAM-433 -- the CycleStateProjection type-doc (losing the 'the two are always called together' contract note), the projectCycleState function-doc's event-log-exception note, and the buildStatusReport inline comment -- landing the file at 1009 lines with no budget entry at all, instead of taking a real-count-derived raise as the same PR correctly did for its other 11 touched files. Restored all three comment blocks to their exact pre-US-002 wording (verified via `git show 32a81b73 -- src/commands/status.ts`) and raised the ceiling 1012->1021 to match the gate-measured `content.split('\n').length` actual, with a dated _ref note (US-R2-003, CAM-433) prepended ahead of the existing chain. No code behavior changed, comment-only + budget-only diff. Verified: `bun -e "console.log(require('fs').readFileSync('src/commands/status.ts','utf8').split('\n').length)"` -> 1021, matching the raised ceiling exactly. Full gates re-run clean: typecheck 0 errors, bun test 5665 pass / 0 fail, bun run check:all all-green (file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, embed-vendor up to date). No patterns.md bullet added: this is a mechanical application of the already-documented gate-satisfied-by-deleting-docs convention (same family as the round-1 jsLiteral finding), not a new insight.
